project.title: Cumberland Ave Atlas
project.location: 1300 block of Cumberland Avenue near Colvin Street, Syracuse, NY

photo_stops.label: West approach
photo_stops.prompt: Capture the approach into the 1300 block, sidewalk condition, lighting, tree canopy, drainage, and signs.

photo_stops.label: Mid-block baseline
photo_stops.prompt: Use the same framing each month to track pavement, curb edges, canopy, set-outs, and daily street use.

photo_stops.label: Colvin corner
photo_stops.prompt: Document crossing comfort, visibility, drainage, turning behavior, and nearby service-request patterns.

walks.summary: Initial Cumberland/Colvin field observations added from phone photos. Original photo files were not available in the local Hermes image cache, so the published page uses descriptive field-photo cards until the image files are copied into the project folder.

photos.label: South to north over Colvin
photos.caption: South-to-north view looking out over Colvin, useful for the Cumberland/Colvin intersection context.
photos.alt_text: View from Cumberland Avenue looking south to north over Colvin Street with intersection pavement, overhead utilities, and mature tree canopy visible.

photos.label: North to south up Cumberland
photos.caption: North-to-south view looking up Cumberland from near Colvin.
photos.alt_text: View looking south up Cumberland Avenue from near Colvin Street with residential lawns, tree canopy, overhead utilities, curbside set-out area, and pavement surface visible.

photos.label: South to north down Cumberland
photos.caption: South-to-north view down Cumberland showing the everyday neighborhood street context.
photos.alt_text: Long view looking north down Cumberland Avenue with residential lawns, tree canopy, overhead wires, parked vehicles, and cracked pavement visible.

photos.label: Road surface crack detail
photos.caption: Close-up of pavement cracking on Cumberland, including edge cracking and loose organic debris on the road surface.
photos.alt_text: Close view of cracked asphalt pavement along the edge of Cumberland Avenue with grass at the roadside and organic debris on the road surface.

field_notes: Residential block context includes mature tree canopy, lawns or grass edges, parked vehicles, and overhead utility lines.
Pavement cracking is visible in both long-view and close-up photos, including longitudinal and branching cracks near the pavement edge.
Pedestrian space and crossing markings are not clearly visible in the provided views; avoid asserting missing infrastructure without a clearer photo or field confirmation.
Repeat the same directions next month and add weather/time-of-day metadata.
